title: Part Fifteen: The Same Playbook, Twice

sections.brief: Vance and Masters side by side: Masters bio (Stanford, Zero to One, COO Thiel Capital, president Thiel Foundation, resigned Mar 2022); Saving Arizona $10M (Apr 2021) + $3.5M (May 2022) = $15M by July (92% of PAC), +$2.5M Oct = $17.5M (Ballotpedia/Forbes ≥$20M); Protect Ohio Values ~$15M; Trump endorsements 15 Apr / 2 Jun 2022; primaries won; SLF $28M Ohio vs $9.6M cancelled Arizona; Thiel's refusal and matching offer (Axios); results; Masters 2024 loss; co-donors (Uihlein, Mercer, Sacks, Winklevoss); FEC letter and MUR 8009 dismissed; documented vs inferred; worst-case reading tested. Figures: compare, money
